mission: CBCT WebGL2 Hardware Sharpening & Misch Bone Density Colormap Overhaul
completed_steps: Phase 1: WebGL2 Context Loss Shield, progressive 2x VRAM downsample retry on OOM, and Multi-DPR clamping (<= 1.5)
Phase 2: Implemented Misch Bone Density D1-D4 colormap heatmap and Endo high contrast modes in CBCT_MPR_FRAGMENT_SHADER and CBCT_PANORAMIC_CURVED_FRAGMENT_SHADER
Phase 2: Implemented hardware unsharp masking / trabecular edge enhancement with Laplacian gradient calculation and anti-air halo protection
Phase 2: Added colorMap and sharpenAmount uniforms and getters/setters in CbctVolumeGlContext.ts
Phase 2: Added Section 15 torture tests in cbctHardwareGpuTorture.test.ts verifying Misch D1-D4 intervals, Laplacian formula, anti-air guard, colormap resolver, and WebGL uniform uploads
Phase 2: Added Section 10 tests in cbctWebGlEngine.test.ts verifying shader declarations, colormap mode uploads, sharpening clamping [0.0, 1.0], and persistence via setColorMap/setSharpenAmount
Machine verification executed: 100/100 tests pass across 27 suites with Exit Code 0 in ~588 ms
Per-file git add completed for all 5 scope files
findings: Misch Bone Density Heatmap: D1 cortical (>1250 HU, pearlescent white), D1/D2 dense trabecular (850..1250 HU, golden yellow), D2/D3 normal trabecular (350..850 HU, emerald green/aquamarine), D4 low density (150..350 HU, warm orange-brown), soft tissue (<150 HU, graphite slate), ambient air (<-700 HU, dark).
Endo High Contrast: Sigmoid steep curve enhances microcracks, vertical fractures, and hidden canals (MB2).

Hardware Unsharp Masking: Uses 4-neighbor cross Laplacian sampling (4*center - sum(neighbors)) on normalized slice basis axes with strict anti-air guard (hu > -700 HU) preventing bright ringing halos.
GlSliceRenderOptions accepts colorMap ('grayscale' | 'bone_density' | 'endo' | 'inverted' or 0..3) and sharpenAmount (0.0..1.0, clamped).
Zero regressions across test suites; 100/100 tests pass.
